with e as (select l.person_key,l.history_id,l.issue_key,l.seconds,i.project_key from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00'),
p as (select person_key,sum(seconds) value from e group by 1 having count(distinct project_key)>=2),
r as (select person_key id,value,rank() over(order by value desc) rk from p)
select id,value from r where rk<=5 order by value desc

with e as (select l.person_key,l.history_id,l.issue_key,l.seconds,i.project_key from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00'),
p as (select person_key,sum(seconds) value from e group by 1 having count(distinct project_key)>=2),
r as (select person_key id,value,rank() over(order by value desc) rk from p)
select r.id,r.value,e.history_id,e.issue_key from r join e on e.person_key=r.id where rk<=5 order by value desc
